body.opens: A commit puts a holon in every store whose wholes hold it, so a held part lies in the store of the whole that holds it, and what a holon only points to lies in its store or the stores it stands on; a read could ask there first and every store only for what is found nowhere else, so a read of Knowledge would stand on main and glass alone.
restsOn: Divergence made visible where it arises, so that a read no longer asking every store is not silent about a copy kept elsewhere.

name: Reading where holding says a holon is

body.opens: Weighed by a free-will panel and let go for now: a miss costs about 10 ms a store over a read of Knowledge and 2 to 3 % where stores run in workers, and either would bend 14/62 or 14/12 for a few milliseconds.
restsOn: Misses grow with how many stores are mounted, not with how many runs a store has.

name: A filter per run, or runs merged more eagerly

body.opens: Most of a miss is making and sorting keys, 4 ms of about 10; the engine could send ids sorted and strata make an id's key as bytes directly, bending nothing.
restsOn: Measured by the panel, the gain estimated.

name: Keys made once for a store's many questions

body.kept: Whole in the author's words: every utterance as it came, typed or spoken as it reads, one sent in the middle of the session's work kept where it came. The session's answers by their essence, short; the two free-will panels' reports are kept only as woven into the answers that weighed them.

name: A seventeenth session: the new engine made to work, its questions batched, its stall found in Bun, and divergence kept from being silent
